remarks: Welcome home to this beautifully renovated & impeccably maintained two-story Colonial, nestled in the highly sought after Eagle Heights neighborhood, & located in the award winning Orchard Park school district! Offering 5 bedrooms/2.5 bathrooms (first floor office with closet as potential 6th bedroom), & an abundance of thoughtfully designed living space, this exceptional home seamlessly blends comfort, style, & functionality. The inviting entry opens up to a spacious interior featuring a desirable open-concept kitchen & family room. The beautifully appointed kitchen showcases white cabinetry, included stainless steel appliances, generous counter space, & ample seating-perfect for everyday living & effortless entertaining. The adjoining family room is complimented by customized shelving with a wet bar, & newer gas fireplace, creating a warm & cozy atmosphere. Just beyond the kitchen & family room, the light-filled four-season room presents cathedral ceilings with skylights, an additional space to enjoy the changing seasons. French doors lead into the dining & living rooms, offering flexibility for hosting family & friends. The second level boasts five generously sized bedrooms, including the massive primary suite, serving as a true private retreat. Designed for comfort & convenience, this impressive space features a double vanity, luxurious soaking tub with jets, a separate shower, & oversized walk-in closet with customized shelving. A sliding glass door off the bedroom opens up to a charming deck where you can unwind & enjoy the peaceful scenery from above. The outdoor living experience continues on the expansive deck below, complete with a retractable awning, gas firepit, & 6-person hot tub beneath a beautiful custom designed gazebo. And the fun doesn't stop there!...Just across the street, the neighborhood park offers a playset, swings, basketball court,, & picnic tables - an added bonus just steps away from home. Don't miss your opportunity to make this Eagle Heights gem your home!
